description: Corrected structure-coverage figure with the measured coverage gaps and the exposure of the observed dynamin determinant
code:
import requests, pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, os
OUT="/agent/jobs/8702c639-95bf-4148-bbca-ab3e5442c5e6/provenance"
for pid in ("9PZZ","9Q00"):
    r=requests.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.pdb",timeout=60)
    print(pid,"legacy PDB format HTTP",r.status_code,"| body starts:",r.text[:60].replace("\n"," "))

inv=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"arc_structure_inventory.csv"))
d4=pd.read_csv(os.path.join(OUT,"arc_4X3H_chainA_sasa.csv"))
cov=np.zeros(398,int)
for _,r in inv.iterrows(): cov[int(r.arc_first):int(r.arc_last)+1]+=1
GAPS=[(1,98),(133,198),(365,396)]

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(13,10))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,1,height_ratios=[2.5,0.95,1.05],hspace=0.45)
a=fig.add_subplot(gs[0]); cols={'human':'#2b6cb0','rat':'#38a169'}
for x0,x1 in GAPS: a.axvspan(x0,x1,color="#feb2b2",alpha=0.45,zorder=0)
for i,(_,r) in enumerate(inv.iterrows()):
    a.barh(i,r.arc_last-r.arc_first+1,left=r.arc_first,height=0.62,color=cols[r.organism],zorder=3)
    a.text(r.arc_last+5,i,f"{int(r.n_arc_chains)} chain"+("s" if r.n_arc_chains>1 else ""),va="center",fontsize=8,color="#333")
a.set_yticks(range(len(inv))); a.set_yticklabels([f"{r.pdb} ({r.organism}, {int(r.year)})" for _,r in inv.iterrows()],fontsize=8.5)
a.set_xlim(0,400); a.invert_yaxis()
a.set_title("A. All 15 parsable mammalian Arc entries are fragments. No entry holds more than 8 Arc chains, so no capsid interface exists to measure.",fontsize=10)
a.legend(handles=[plt.Line2D([],[],color=cols['human'],lw=7,label='human Q7LC44'),
                  plt.Line2D([],[],color=cols['rat'],lw=7,label='rat Q63053'),
                  plt.Line2D([],[],color="#feb2b2",lw=7,label='no coordinates anywhere: 1-98, 133-198, 365-396')],
         fontsize=8,loc="lower right")
b=fig.add_subplot(gs[1])
b.fill_between(range(1,397),cov[1:397],step="mid",color="#4a5568")
b.axvspan(89,100,color="#d69e2e",alpha=0.6); b.axvspan(195,214,color="#d69e2e",alpha=0.6)
b.axvspan(99,132,color="#2b6cb0",alpha=0.35)
b.text(94,13,"endophilin\n89-100",ha="center",fontsize=8); b.text(205,13,"dynamin\n195-214",ha="center",fontsize=8)
b.text(116,10.5,"NT coil 99-132",ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#2b6cb0")
b.set_ylim(0,17); b.set_xlim(0,400); b.set_ylabel("entries covering\nthe residue"); b.set_xlabel("Arc residue number (396 aa)")
b.set_title("B. Coverage depth. 49 % of the sequence has never been seen in any structure.",fontsize=10)
c=fig.add_subplot(gs[2])
dyn=d4[(d4.resi>=199)&(d4.resi<=214)]; body=d4[(d4.resi>=215)&(d4.resi<=275)]
c.bar(dyn.aa+dyn.resi.astype(str),dyn.rel,color="#d69e2e")
c.axhline(body.rel.mean(),ls="--",c="k",lw=1)
c.text(0.01,body.rel.mean()+0.03,"mean for the folded N-lobe body 215-275 = %.2f"%body.rel.mean(),fontsize=8,transform=c.get_yaxis_transform())
c.set_ylabel("relative SASA"); c.set_ylim(0,1.0)
c.set_title("C. The observed part of the dynamin determinant (199-214 in 4X3H) is an exposed extension: mean relative SASA 0.51, 11 of 16 residues above 0.4",fontsize=9.5)
plt.show()
